findings.title: Metric alert handler can no longer be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits abstract methods from StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of them: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data remain abstract. Accessing detector_handler on a Detector with type="metric_alert_fire" therefore raises TypeError when the model instantiates the registered handler, causing process_detectors to abort instead of returning the previous empty evaluation. Keep this handler concrete until its stateful implementation is available.

findings.title: Expected occurrence uses the wrong group key in the dedupe test
findings.body: This test builds its expected occurrence for group key "val1", but the subsequent evaluate_group_key_value call evaluates "group_key". The mock handler builds occurrence fingerprints from that argument, so the expected occurrence has fingerprint "<detector_id>:val1" while the actual occurrence has "<detector_id>:group_key". The result equality assertion therefore fails before the test reaches its deduplication check. Build the expected occurrence using "group_key".
